entries.title: Draft electronic submission template guidance for PMA applications
entries.summary: FDA published draft guidance describing resources and content supporting electronic PMA submissions. The document is not for implementation while it remains a draft.

entries.title: CDRH learning resources for medical-device development tools
entries.summary: FDA updated its CDRH Learn collection with material covering medical-device development tools and related regulatory topics.

entries.title: FDA updates its list of AI-enabled medical devices
entries.summary: The public list provides a current reference point for AI-enabled devices authorized for marketing in the United States.
